t: The Milwaukee Shockwave 1/4" Hex Magnetic Bit Holder Drive Guide 75mm manufactured from custom‑engineered steel with optimised heat treatment delivers maximum strength and flexibility for demanding applications. An optimised Shockzone absorbs more torque to reduce shock from impact driving, while a strong magnetic tip ensures a secure grip on fasteners. Featuring a ¼" hex reception, this bit holder is ideal for high‑torque and impact applications.
